chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But [He granted authority] over those who take him as their guardian and disobey His command.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifying that Satan's *sultan* (authority/power) is not inherent or absolute over the *Mu'minun* (believers) but is contingent upon their voluntary submission through *khasf* (obedience) to his whispers. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle that while Satan can influence the faithful, he cannot compel them to disbelief unless they choose to follow his path, thereby preserving human free will and the possibility of spiritual elevation.
